Easy M&Ms Easter Individual Parfaits

A delicious and easy to make Easter dessert

5 from 1 vote
Course
Dessert
Cuisine
American
Keyword
Easter, parfait
Prep Time
10 minutes
Cook Time
0 minutes
Total Time
10 minutes
Servings
4 servings
Calories
280 kcal
Author
Debi

Ingredients

  • Whipped Chocolate Ganache layer:
    • ½ cup chocolate chips
    • ¼ cup heavy whipping cream
  • Whipped cream layer:
    • ½ cup heavy whipping cream
    • 2 tablespoons powdered sugar
  • Layers:
    • Graham Cracker Crumbs
    • M&M's Speckled Eggs

Instructions

  1. In a large microwave proof bowl, heat the chocolate chips and the ¼ cup cream in 30-second increments in the microwave, stirring well after each cooking time, until the chocolate is melted and smooth. Set aside to allow to cool to room temperature, you can place the chocolate mixture in the fridge, but don't allow it to get so cold that it hardens.
  2. In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, add ½ cup whipping cream and the powdered sugar. Whip using a hand held mixer or the stand mixer until stiff peaks form.
  3. Again, using the hand held mixer or the stand mixer, whip the chocolate ganache until soft peaks form.
  4. Now, the layering happens!

  • Whipped cream layer:
    • ½ cup heavy whipping cream
    • 2 tablespoons powdered sugar
  • Layers:

    • M&M's Speckled Eggs

Instructions

  1. In a large microwave-proof bowl, heat the chocolate chips and the ¼ cup cream in 30-second increments, stirring well after each, until melted and smooth. Set aside to cool to room temperature. You can place it in the fridge, but don't let it harden.
  2. In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, add ½ cup whipping cream and the powdered sugar. Whip using a hand-held or stand mixer until stiff peaks form.
  3. Again, using the mixer, whip the cooled chocolate ganache until soft peaks form.
